title: Psychic predicts orbs over the ocean at the Round Table

tellings.quote: this psychic would just blurt out, you know, "11:00, you know, tonight." And they'd go out and they would see an orb.

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, describes the journals of Andrija Puharich, a scientist the episode links to the CIA, the US intelligence agency, who ran a research group called the Round Table Foundation on the coast of Maine in the early 1950s. According to Malatzi, a psychic there would suddenly announce a time, like "11:00 tonight", and the group would go outside then and see a glowing ball of light, an orb, over the ocean. If true, it would suggest a human mind could somehow predict or call up these lights.
